name: regex-highlighter
description: Generate color highlighting, optimization, and other features for regexes.

scripts.build-js: browserify --debug src/index.js -p esmify > web/bundle.js ; [[ ${PIPESTATUS[0]} -eq 0 ]] && [[ ${PIPESTATUS[1]} -eq 0 ]] || notify -t 'JS Build Error' -m 'Browserify encountered a build error.' -x false;
scripts.build-css: find web/ -name '*.less' -print0 | xargs -0 -n1 -I '{}' lessc {} web/bundle.css || notify -t 'CSS Build Error' -m 'Less encountered a build error.' -x false

author: Danny Brian
